quiz.title: Supply and Demand
quiz.subject: Mathematics

concepts.definition: The amount of a product or service that producers are willing to sell.
The amount of a product or service that consumers are willing to buy.

quiz.notes: Dear Parents, please help your child with these activities...
successCriteria: I can understand the principles of supply and demand

questions.question: What is supply?
questions.answer: The amount of a product or service that producers are willing to sell
questions.hint: Think about what supply means in the context of a market
questions.solution: Supply refers to the amount of a product or service that producers are willing to sell. It is an important concept in economics because it helps determine the price of goods and services.
questions.diagramDescription: A diagram showing the relationship between supply and demand

questions.question: What is demand?
questions.answer: The amount of a product or service that consumers are willing to buy
questions.hint: Think about what demand means in the context of a market
questions.solution: Demand refers to the amount of a product or service that consumers are willing to buy. It is an important concept in economics because it helps determine the price of goods and services.
questions.diagramDescription: A diagram showing the relationship between supply and demand

questions.question: How do supply and demand affect the price of goods and services?
questions.answer: When supply is high and demand is low, prices tend to fall. When supply is low and demand is high, prices tend to rise.
questions.hint: Think about how supply and demand interact to determine prices
questions.solution: The price of goods and services is determined by the interaction of supply and demand. When supply is high and demand is low, prices tend to fall because there is more supply than demand. On the other hand, when supply is low and demand is high, prices tend to rise because there is more demand than supply.
questions.diagramDescription: A diagram showing the relationship between supply and demand
